title: Packet Checkpoint Tool PATH-Configured Runtime Live Retest
summary: Retest forgepilot_record_packet_checkpoint after configuring both FORGEPILOT_PNPM_BIN and PATH in the MCP service environment, proving the typed checkpoint tool can complete packet creation, evidence admission, and commit without terminal packet creation.
caveats: This validates the checkpoint tool configured runtime path only; it does not authorize or test execution gates.
This checkpoint does not run FP-027 or any canary.
The configured PATH and pnpm path are service-runtime configuration, not repository code.
FP-MCP-204 previously showed that FORGEPILOT_PNPM_BIN alone was insufficient because the pnpm shim uses /usr/bin/env node.
boundaries: no request artifact mutated outside this checkpoint's declared artifacts

structuredRecord.expectedFix: checkpoint tool can run the pnpm shim because node is now resolvable on the service PATH
